technique_name: Explain the concept of absolute advantage.
description: Absolute advantage is a concept in economics that refers to the ability of an individual, company, or country to produce goods or services more efficiently than its competitors. It determines which country has the greatest ability to produce goods and services, in comparison to others. Countries that have absolute advantage are able to produce more goods or services for the same amount of resources than other countries.
